leadText:
Pikachu Shocks Back issue 4 is the eighth monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the eighth chapter of the manga, You Gotta Have Friends. 

The contents of this issue were included as part of along with ET05, ET06, and ET07.
